svg.title: US115 — Create a maintenance record (aircraft set UNDER_MAINTENANCE through B3b)

g.text: US115 — Create a maintenance record (aircraft set UNDER_MAINTENANCE through B3b)
(executed by the owner replica of the aircraft)
if rolled back → PATCH previous status (compensation)
"Aircraft under maintenance cannot be assigned to flights": Flight Routes only schedules aircraft whose
status is AVAILABLE (B1a), so the status set here blocks new flights without Flight Routes calling Maintenance.
